label: Horizontal Layout
description: Panels stacked top to bottom. Best for a header pane over a content pane, split 25 to 75, with a line dragged up and down.

label: Vertical Layout
description: Panels side by side. Best for a sidebar beside a content pane, split 25 to 75, with a line dragged left and right.

label: Mixed Directions
description: Mixed directions. Best for a side pane beside a column that splits again into top and bottom, 3 panes in 2 directions.

label: Nested Grips
description: Nested grips. Best for equal halves where the right half splits 25 to 75 top and bottom, on grip handles.

label: Animated Pill
description: Pill handle. Best for a short pill on a 30 to 70 split that lengthens and turns primary while dragged.

label: Spring Pill
description: Pill handle on equal halves. Best for a pill that stretches and turns primary while dragged.

label: Capsule Expansion
description: Pill handle top to bottom. Best for a pill on a horizontal divider that widens while dragged.

label: Nested Pills
description: Nested pill handles. Best for navigation beside a toolbar over an editor, with a pill on each divider.

label: Three Panels
description: Three panels. Best for files, editor and preview in one row split 25, 50 and 25, with 2 pill handles and a minimum size on every pane.

label: Size Tracking
description: Size readouts. Best for live percentages in each pane, fed from the group's sizes into state as the divider moves.
